patch.summary:
Choose Notion only if your buying job matches “Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo ann” rather than Todoist's shape. Choose Todoist only if your buying job matches “Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/” rather than Notion's shape. Workflow advantage: Notion leans team-collaboration-work, work-management; Todoist leans project-tracking. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Notion is Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo annual; AI on Business.; Todoist is Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/mo annual; Business ~$10..
- Workflow coverage skew: Notion-leaning team-collaboration-work, work-management vs Todoist-leaning project-tracking.
- Researched limits: Notion — Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management; Todoist — Not a Work OS or portfolio tool.

Limitations — Notion: Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management; Reporting/dashboards thinner than dedicated PM tools; Todoist: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business.
